contract_policy.atomicity: all declared writes, exact commands, required verification, and one terminal receipt form one indivisible acceptance unit
contract_policy.failure: no pass receipt; preserve diagnostics; stop the frontier
contract_policy.closeout: receipt written last after independent read-only audit; next unit rehashes it
contract_policy.manifest_lifecycle: immutable planning history; execution state is recorded in receipts, not rewritten into this manifest
contract_policy.semantic_closeout: Every affected receipt repeats the S1 epoch and contract digest; later units rehash both before admission.
